Be careful! (Be careful! (Page 22) I didn’t expect it to be so humane! Nie Feng said in surprise after seeing the look in the female toad’s eyes. Don’t they know how tempting the benefits of joining a famous sect are? After Pei Huan finished speaking, he quickly knelt down to plead guilty. He was afraid that the emperor would be angry with him because of this. After all, these words came from his mouth, and he would have a certain responsibility. While Zhang Sanfeng was walking, he suddenly felt a feeling in his heart. A huge danger came, and suddenly a black shadow flashed in the dark passage ahead, and the fierce aura made people feel uncomfortable. The black shadow emerged and bit the two of them. At that time, Yunxiu's alchemy skills had improved a lot, so she gave her second aunt a prescription to see if the elixir in the space could cure cousin Li's illness. "For the sake of Jin country, for your imperial grandfather, the Ai family abandoned my mother who loved me the most, abandoned the Tang Mu royal family, and abandoned everything. There is a way out. The Ai family only hopes that the Jin Kingdom will last forever, and that when they go to see your imperial grandfather, they can smile with a smile!" The Empress Dowager's eyes showed nostalgia when she mentioned the former Emperor. Hongjun had never seen him so rich. The shocking scene almost made me dizzy. I thought it was a good thing I didn't let Li Jinglong do it himself. Even if Li Jinglong went to Liuying Chunxiao on weekdays, it was an elegant place. How could he have so directly crashed into the gold-selling cave where he had returned to his animal nature? Where? "Where is his family?" Mo Rigen knew that there was such a family. Li Jinglong also confessed that when he was not in Chang'an, he asked Mo Rigen to visit him often, but Mo Rigen always put down the money and left. Now Duan and Ma are missing. I guessed that something unexpected might have happened. Although it was already in the afternoon, the entire West Market was still bustling with people. Qi Qiu observed quietly that the clothes and behavior of these people were extraordinary, and they looked like they were either rich or noble.
